description: The symbol-level graph — declarations and the references between them — with summary stats. Requires path (scope to one file) or limit (bound nodes). Very large on a big repository. If you are looking for one symbol use find_symbol or search_symbols, and for its callers use find_references.

limit.description: Maximum items to return (default 50, max 500). The response reports totalCount and truncated so you can tell whether you saw everything.

path.description: Workspace-relative file to scope the graph to.

name: knowledge_graph
title: Knowledge graph
